correctness.rationale: The standalone source recomputes the three complete face complexes by inductive enumeration, independently matches their counts by eight-state transfer matrices, checks every directed Hasse incidence and acyclicity, calculates full integral Morse boundaries via signed gradient paths, and proves exact ranks 3,5,5 with unit maximal minors. Original simplicial boundary matrices reduced separately over F2 agree in every dimension. The resulting CW complexes have only one vertex and cells in two adjacent dimensions >=3, so the integer attachments classify their homotopy types by the Hurewicz identification. No extrapolation from finite n occurs.

value.rationale: The 2023 paper explicitly names C7×K3, C8×K3 and C10×K3 as the first computational mixed-dimensional cases beyond the classified divisible-by-three and small-cycle regimes, then asks whether such complexes are torsion-free. These are exactly the first three unresolved lengths with three colors and represent both nonzero residues mod 3. Complete integral homotopy types answer the finite torsion/possible-Moore question; this is a motivated finite cutoff with meaningful attachment data rather than an arbitrary slice or mere field homology recomputation.
